question: What quality and durability factors make GCM Safety Nets reliable?
answer:

We understand that safety is paramount, which is why all our safety nets are manufactured using premium-grade High-Density Polyethylene (HDPE) material. This crucial feature prevents material degradation, fading, and brittleness over time, ensuring the nets retain their structural integrity and protective capabilities for years.
